messages:
tara_pm: Kicking off thread for the routing-fallbacks rollout pattern. Need a compact plan: flag schema, region ordering, canary slices, A/B vs canary rules, and a clear fast-kill/rollback ladder. Goal: hosted + dedicated first, private later behind KMS checks. Please keep comments short.

grace_eng: +1. My rough flow: shadow (no impact) -> micro-canary (0.25%) -> small canary (1%) -> regional ramp (10%) -> broad ramp (>25%). Each step must have baked telemetry gates + an automated soft-fail.

omar_sre: SRE constraints: require KV warmup before traffic shifts. Gate rules: p95 delta <= 12% OR absolute error increase <= 0.2% -> soft rollback (reduce slice to 0.05%). If threshold breaches persist for 10m, escalate to tenant or region kill. Add 15m cooldown to avoid flapping.

leo_support: Support wants: a) portal opt-in for up to 6 enterprise customers b) one-click rollback in portal for those opt-ins c) webhook to notify support on tenant-level kills. We'll manage comms if we have template.

devops: Flag naming: use v-tagging and scope: `ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.enabled`, `ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.slice_pct`, `ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.scope` (global|region|tenant), `ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.kill.global`, `ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.kill.tenant:<id>`. Audit every toggle. Example config snippet (typed config): `{\"ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.enabled\":true, \"ff.routing_fallbacks.v1.slice_pct\":1}`.

grace_eng: Telemetry gates (proposed): p50/p95/p99, error-rate, fallback_invocations, reroute_rate, host_cpu. Suggested thresholds: p95 delta <= 12%, error_rate delta <= 0.15% abs, reroute_rate <= 1% abs, host_cpu < 75%. If gate trips for 5m -> auto soft rollback.

omar_sre: Rollback ladder (deterministic): 1) soft auto -> slice_pct -> 0.05% (automated) 2) tenant kill (automated if tenant breach) 3) region rollback (manual on-call approval) 4) global kill-switch (manual exec). Document times and owners for each step.

leo_support: For enterprise opt-ins we'll notify customers 48h in advance and tag their org with test windows. Also want a canned status blurb. I'll draft and post for review.

devops: We'll add an admin endpoint that flips `kill.tenant:<id>` and emits an audit event. Portal work and webhook tracked in RI-14033. infra-bot: ticket RI-14033 created and assigned.

grace_eng: A/B vs canary rules: use canary for infra and latency-sensitive metrics. Use A/B only for UX/perf metrics (completion quality, helpfulness proxies). Keep cohorts disjoint — no user should be in both tests.

omar_sre: Sampling plan for traces: 100% of micro-canary requests (volume small), 10% at 1%, 2% beyond. All traces redacted and stored encrypted.

tara_pm: Quick decisions so we can move to owners: 1) Progressive lattice: shadow -> 0.25% -> 1% -> 10% -> 25+. 2) Flag schema with v1 and per-scope kill switches. 3) Telemetry gates and automated soft rollback + cooldown. 4) Portal opt-in for 6 customers + webhook + audit logs. 5) Private blocked until KMS legal sign-off.

leo_support: Action items: I'll draft customer blurb + FAQ.

devops: Action items: implement flag wiring, admin toggle, webhook, audit.

grace_eng: Action: rollout script + dry-run toggle that doesn't change live routing but exercises flow.

omar_sre: Action: gate automation + cooldown + runbook.

infra-bot: dry-run scheduled RI-14033 -> dry-run target 2026-04-09T07:00:00Z. Assigned: grace_eng, omar_sre, devops.

tara_pm: Thanks. If anyone sees gaps call them out here. Otherwise I'll consolidate into a one-pager for shiproom. :white_check_mark:
